The nbfx Wizard API provides the pure-JavaFX wizard framework: the FxWizard and FxWizardPanel SPI, the registry that discovers wizards from the layer, and the dialog that runs them.
Wizards are declared with @WizardRegistration and discovered from NbFx/Wizards. FxWizardDialog shows the pages with Back / Next / Finish / Cancel, gating Next and Finish on page validity.
New Project creates a build-tool project.
New File creates a source file from a template.
The registry is unit-tested. The API is under development until the MVP freeze.
A JDK is required only to compile; JavaFX is provided by the runtime.
Only com.gluonhq.netbeans.nbfx.platform.wizard is public.
Wizards are read from the configuration filesystem under NbFx/Wizards.
